subject: general
question: The final match for Irani Trophy 2024-25, which was won by Mumbai, was conducted at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mumbai Cricket team, led by Ajinkya Rahane, won the 2024–25 Irani Cup by defeating the Rest of India Team.

 
• This victory marks Mumbai's 15th Irani Cup title and their first since 1997.
 
• The tournament was held from 1st to 5th October 2024 at the Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Eakana Stadium in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Mumbai Cricket Team received a cash prize of Rs 50 Lakhs from the BCCI and an additional Rs 1 crore from the Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA).
 
• The Rest of India team was captained by Ruturaj Gaikwad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Irani Cup__

 __
 
• Inception - 1959-60 to honor Z.R. Irani, a prominent cricket administrator
 
• Format - First-class cricket match held annually between the Ranji Trophy winners and the Rest of India
 
 
 
• Mumbai Cricket Team__
 __
 
• Record - 15 Irani Cup titles, renowned for a strong cricketing legacy in Indian domestic cricket
 
• Captain (2024–25) - Ajinkya Rahane
 
 
 
• Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Eakana Stadium__
 
 
• Location - Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh
 
• Significance - One of India's premier cricket venues, hosting national and international matches
